result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but one clear visual defect stands out: a stray horizontal black bar is drawn across the bottom navigation, overlapping the search and orders icons. No other significant breakages were found beyond expected carousel/viewport clipping (excluded per instructions).

issues.description: A stray horizontal black line/bar stretches across the bottom navigation, cutting through the search (magnifier) and orders (receipt) icons. It looks like a misplaced divider, progress bar, or home-indicator element rendered at the wrong position, obscuring the tab icons.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the rogue bar element (e.g., fix its z-index/anchor so it doesn't overlay the tab bar), ensuring all navigation icons render cleanly and remain fully tappable.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels and no visible active-state indicator besides the green home icon color, which may be ambiguous for users and low-vision accessibility.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each tab icon or a clearer active-state treatment (pill background, label) to improve clarity and accessibility.
